1. Data measured from a 12.8 m long composite beam test conducted at National Fire Research Laboratory (NFRL) at the National Institute of Standard and Technology (NIST) is provided here. A total of 5 Specimens were tested.  Table 1 provided below shows the Test Matrix.
2. This file "NFRL_CompositeBeamTest_TestSetup_and_InstrumentationLayout" provides the test setup drawings and instrumentation layouts.
3. In this Excel file, Tab "TestSetupDrawings" provides the drawings depicting the test setup.
4. Tab "InstrumentationLayout-AmbTest" provides the instrumentation layout for the test of Specimen CB-DA-AMB conducted at ambient temperature.
5. Tab "InstrumentationLayout-FireTests" provides the instrumentation layout for the strcutural fire tests (Specimens CB-DA, CB-DA-SC, CB-SP, and CB-SP-SC).
6. Tab "Channel List-AmbientTest" provides a list of the sensors used in the test of Specimen CB-DA-AMB and their labels, locations, and the measurement units.
7. Tab "Channel List-FireTests" provides a list of the sensors used in strcutural fire tests (Specimens CB-DA, CB-DA-SC, CB-SP, and CB-SP-SC) and their labels, locations, and the measurement units.
8. The files "CB-DA-AMP", "CB-DA", "CB-DA-SC", "CB-SP", and "CB-SP-SC" provides the data measured during the tests of Specimens CB-DA-AMB, CB-DA, CB-DA-SC, CB-SP, and CB-SP-SC, respectively.
9. Refer to Choe et al. (2019) and Ramesh et al. (2019) for detailed descriptions of the test program, test results, and measurement uncertainties.

1. Choe, L., Ramesh, S., Hoehler, M., Seif, M., Bundy, M. (2019). “Compartment Fire Experiments of Long-Span Composite-Beams with Simple Shear Connections. Part II: Test Results”. NIST Technical Note-2055, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Gaithersburg, MD

2. Ramesh, S., Choe, L., Seif, M., Hoehler, M., Grosshandler, W., Sauca, A., Bundy, M. (2019). “Compartment Fire Experiments of Long-Span Composite-Beams with Simple Shear Connections. Part I: Experiment Design and Behavior at Ambient Temperature”. NIST Technical Note-2054, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Gaithersburg, MD
